_comment: Only local Ollama/Code Llama conditions are executed automatically. ChatGPT and Claude are evaluated through their web applications using export-manual/import-manual. Sampling settings for Code Llama inherit from config/llm_config.json.

codellama_agent.label: Code Llama + the existing tutoring agent (state machine, guards, fallbacks). Reference condition, not part of the like-for-like comparison.

codellama_prompt.label: Code Llama with the controlled prompt only (model/base_url/timeout come from config/llm_config.json). num_ctx is set explicitly because the ~2k-token prompt overflows Ollama's default window, which would silently cut off the system prompt.
